meta.name: WandaVision
meta.description: Wanda Maximoff and Vision—two super-powered beings living idealized suburban lives—begin to suspect that everything is not as it seems.

videos.title: Filmed Before a Live Studio Audience
videos.overview: Wanda and Vision struggle to conceal their powers during dinner with Vision’s boss and his wife.

videos.title: Don't Touch That Dial
videos.overview: In an effort to fit in, Wanda and Vision perform a magic act in their community talent show.

videos.title: Now in Color
videos.overview: Wanda's pregnancy fritzes her powers as she and Vision prepare for an accelerated delivery.

videos.title: We Interrupt This Program
videos.overview: Monica Rambeau, tasked with a special assignment regarding sentient weapons, goes missing.

videos.title: On a Very Special Episode...
videos.overview: Wanda addresses Vision's worries when he grows suspicious of the neighbors' strange behavior.

videos.title: All-New Halloween Spooktacular!
videos.overview: Disturbances on Halloween separate Wanda from Vision, who looks into anomalous activity in Westview.

videos.title: Breaking the Fourth Wall
videos.overview: Monica plots her return to the anomaly while Wanda navigates a slew of unsettling complications, and Vision forms a new alliance to help.

videos.title: Previously On
videos.overview: Wanda embarks on a troubling journey revisiting her past for insight into her present and future.

videos.title: The Series Finale
videos.overview: The events of WandaVision come to a head, and the destinies of all who took part are determined.

meta.slogan: Experience a new vision of reality.
